|lore=Vibrating blade powered by an energy cell hidden within the shaft. Used by many moisture farmers to prod banthas and other animals.
|game_text=Use 3 Force to deploy on any alien warrior. Adds 1 to power. May target a character using 1 Force. Both players draw destiny. Target immediately excluded from battle if warrior's power + your destiny &gt; target's power + opponent's destiny.

|rulings=* The destiny drawn by the owner of [[Vibro-Ax]] is a weapon destiny.<ref name="scomp" />
